$comment: The guided demo path as data, run by src/guided/GuidedPath.svelte (step logic: src/guided/steps.js). Each step has an id, a title, plain-words text, `done` (the app state that completes it; the step then advances on its own), an optional `hint` (text shown while its `when` holds and `done` doesn't), and an optional `action` (the 'Try this' button). Conditions: songLoaded {song}, keyChosen {tonic, mode}, keyCommitted, chordAt {bar, beat, numeral}, tutorReplied. Actions: loadSong {song}, press {within, name} (a button by its accessible name inside an element id), openChords {bar, beat}, audition {bar, beat, numeral}, askTutor {lesson} (the question from content/lessons/plan.json; the server replays content/lessons/recorded/<lesson>.json when it exists). Bars and beats are checked against the song by tests/guided/steps.test.js. Stream I scripts video from it.

steps.title: Hear a tune you know
steps.text: Ode to Joy opens with its key hidden: no numbers, no colors. Press Play on the staff and hum along.

steps.title: Find home with the drone chords
steps.text: Under 'What key is this tune in?', choose 'Help me find it'. Play the tune over each chord: over the wrong one some notes rub, over home they settle. Then click the home note.

hint.text: Does the tune settle over that home? Choose 'Check it by ear' and play it over each chord again.

steps.title: Hear the question at bar 4
steps.text: The first phrase ends on a long note at bar 4, beat 3. Put V under it: the tune stops, but it sounds like a question, waiting for an answer.

steps.title: Lean toward the end
steps.text: The tune ends '3 2 1'. Put V under the 2, at bar 8, beat 1, so the last note has something to land from.

steps.title: Try a chord that doesn't land
steps.text: Now put vi under the last note, at bar 8, beat 3. It contains the note, so it fits on paper, but listen: the end swerves sad and sideways instead of arriving home.

action.label: Hear vi under the last note

steps.title: Now let it land
steps.text: Swap the last chord for I, the home chord. V then I is the sound of arriving: the question from bar 4 finally gets its answer.

action.label: Hear I under the last note

steps.title: Ask the tutor why
steps.text: You just heard the difference. Ask the tutor what you felt, and it explains in plain words.
